about: CUSTOMER-side store logos for the Customer Order App order screen (Grid.html header). Each is the store's OWN original logo: resized only (fit inside 600x160, never enlarged), no crop, no recolor, no redraw, except The Residence (Brian's approved exception, dark gray lettering to white). Every logo sits bare on the dark header (25 Oct: no plates). Files in plate/ are retired, kept for history. Customers.LogoUrl holds the path below (e.g. 'meathouse.webp' or 'plate/femis.webp'). Served at https://employee.cooneyprovisions.com/logos/.
rules: Original files only. Resize only, no crop/recolor/redraw. HARD RULE (Brian, 25 Oct): every logo file has a truly transparent background. Colors may be changed so a logo reads on the dark header; the logo and brand never are (Brian, 25 Oct).
